verdict.rationale: Anrok's API docs describe the core mechanism. Each product is identified by an external ID and assigned a product tax category that determines its taxability in each jurisdiction. Sellers create products per unique tax category, and an API endpoint maps billing-system products many-to-1 onto those Anrok products. Missing for 10: evidence of the actual category taxonomy (SaaS vs. digital goods vs. services vs. physical products), explicit per-line-item category handling on transactions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
